title: Az-Zalzalah 99:7-8 with words spaced, and the questions
subject: Qur'an & Tajweed
unit: Summer 1: Al-'Adiyat, Az-Zalzalah and reading from the mushaf
source: Written for quran/y2 lesson 56 (Pupil PDF worksheet: Az-Zalzalah 99:7-8 with words spaced, and the questions)
intro: Lesson 56. Read each word slowly, pointing with your finger. Only the Arabic is the Qur'an; the English is a translation of its meaning.

arabic.text: فَمَن يَعْمَلْ مِثْقَالَ ذَرَّةٍ خَيْرًۭا يَرَهُۥ (٧) وَمَن يَعْمَلْ مِثْقَالَ ذَرَّةٍۢ شَرًّۭا يَرَهُۥ (٨)

head: Ayah
Translation of the meaning (Saheeh International)
rows: So whoever does an atom's weight of good will see it,
And whoever does an atom's weight of evil will see it.

questions.q: Chunk and link Az-Zalzalah 99:7-8 with the teacher.
Listening turns: today's group says 99:7-8 to the teacher, one by one. Everyone else: say it softly 3 times looking, 3 times without.
questions.a: Pupil recites with no help; the teacher marks hifdh and tajweed on the rubric and gives one target.

questions.q: Do three small good deeds today and tell a grown-up.
questions.a: For example: smile, share, tidy up.

questions.q: 99:7 says even a tiny good deed will be ...
questions.a: A) seen. 99:7: 'whoever does an atom's weight of good will see it.'

questions.q: Az-Zalzalah 99:7: «فَمَن يَعْمَلْ ...» Which word comes next?
Think again: Is a tiny kind action, like smiling or picking up litter, too small to matter?
questions.a: No! Allah sees even an atom's weight of good, and it will be shown to us (99:7).
